page.overview:
What is Tentacle?

The Tentacle is an animal native to LV-1201.

Tentacles are worm-like subterranean predators with a beige, reptilian hide. Its has no jaws, instead possessing a round mouth lined by a rozette of backwards-facing teeth. It also has rudimentary eyes, suggesting its ancestors lived above ground. Tentacles hunt in packs, attacking their prey from below the ground like a terrestrial version of the crocodile. When attacking, they can rise up to two meters into the air.

Both Dunya and the Ancient Predator encounter these organisms on LV-1201. They are very easy to kill depending on difficulty level.
